verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes broad payment-related functionality via API (checkouts, refunds, terminal payments, webhooks, multi-reader management) and even AI-native access via an MCP server and Agent Toolkit, suggesting strong API-first design. However, there is no evidence of full parity with the merchant UI — features like plan/subscription management, marketing promotions, or account settings shown in the pricing/dashboard pages have no documented API equivalents, and an OpenAPI spec probe failed to resolve, making comprehensive parity unverifiable. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP coverage for account administration, plan management, and marketing tools, plus a discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint parity.
